derivation_disclosure: Frozen after r7.76 majority-horizon target passed with median/minimum source AUROC 0.967742/0.719595 and pair ordering 0.942308. This replay changes only the prototype training target relative to failed r7.73; its three-frame baseline, two-positive-sample open rule, zero threshold and lifecycle are unchanged. Bangkok remains post-hoc and receives no prospective credit.

target.semantics: at least two of the fixed three future-route horizons hit the marker

prototype_ensemble.model: unit mean of source-bootstrap majority-positive minus nearest non-strong same-source deltas
prototype_ensemble.aggregation: median of five event-relative prototype projections

causal_profile.prerequisite: frozen r7.25 radial candidate already exists
causal_profile.baseline: per prototype median of first three accepted event samples only
causal_profile.risk_profile: median across prototypes of current projection minus prototype baseline
causal_profile.clear: reuse frozen event-local r7.30 nine consecutive absent samples
